ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver — this ruling was made without human review; either of you may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

1. Was the route longer than it should have been? The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02842) measures the route actually driven at 14.44 km between the recorded pickup at 06:34:18 and the recorded dropoff at 06:53:08. The booked optimal route (EV-TRIP-02842) is 12.0 km. That is an excess of 2.44 km, or 20.33% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires BOTH tests: more than 0.8 km absolute (2.44 km — passed) and more than 20% of optimal (20.33% — passed, but only just). The trace figure governs, not the rounded 14.4 km on the trip record. The deviation is established. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 50% and under 8.0 km), so no POL-RD-06 pattern check or uplift arises.

2. The driver's explanation. The driver says the detour was minor and caused by a road-works sign. POL-RD-13 tests that against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02842-01, is MISSING: status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, no payload, because no advisory covered this corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 cannot be run — no road is named, no validity window can be compared, no alternative distance exists to cap an exoneration — so the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and the excess is not reduced. I record that no advisory was on file. This does not send the case to a human: the driver cited no advisory identifier, and under POL-RD-13(1) an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be treated as an exculpatory clause invoked against one — the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged.

3. No other excuse applies. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02842) is empty — 0 messages — so there is no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04. Neither endpoint was amended and amended_optimal_distance_km is null (POL-RD-05 cannot run). Vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not displace the 12.0 km baseline.

4. The trace is clean. 114 fixes at 10 s intervals, 100% coverage, zero gaps, no jump over 500 m, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) are not met, no independent corroboration is needed and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. Trip identifiers and timestamps match across the trip record, trace and fare breakdown, and no artifact runs backwards.

5. The refund. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. Recomputing on the optimal route: base fare 3.80 + distance (0.75 × 12.0 = 9.00) + time (0.28 × 16.0 = 4.48) = 17.28, times the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = 17.28, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP, 0.00 surcharges and 0.00 waiting time, less 0.00 promo = 18.08. Charged total: 20.66. Refund: 20.66 − 18.08 = 2.58, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 2.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and the refund share of charged_total is 12.49%, well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60 to the rider.

6. Pass-through lines. No ERP gantries and no tolls were charged and no airport surcharge applies, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is counted twice; no billing-integrity referral arises. The distance billed (14.4 km) matches the trace (14.44 km), so no driver compensation under POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb arises; driver_compensation_sgd is null.

7. Profiles. Both profile checks were run only for the tests that name them: the rider's citable claim counters are 0, and the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 396 completed trips in 90 days (ratio 0.0), so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows. Every other profile field is context only under POL-GEN-01 and decides nothing.

8. Confidence and execution. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-GPS-02842, EV-TRIP-02842 and EV-FARE-02842 — has weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below that; I set it at 0.88 because the 20.33% excess clears the 20% gate only narrowly. It is above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation under POL-RD-10(1). The monetary effect, SGD 2.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this refund executes on issue under POL-GEN-05, subject to appeal. No referral is made: no clause of this policy produces one on these facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
